title: Pinned showcase
description: A large media stage stays in place while three to five pictures or clips change: each step wipes the next one in with a different mask (GSAP clip-path tweens with step labels), the one before sinks back, and the number, title and line beside it change with a progress line. One click per step on a slide; on a web page the screen stays pinned and the scroll moves through the pictures. A video item plays only while it is on show. Nothing is drawn on the pictures.

props.items: required, 3-5 of {src, title, label, text, poster, alt, face}: src is a picture or a video (mp4/webm); label is a small line above the title; face is [x, y, w, h] when the picture shows a person
props.title: one small line under the kicker
